name: Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme
benefit:
- A monthly grant of ₹15,000 per Gram Panchayat for operational expenses.
**NOTE:** Electronic fund transfer mechanism for timely disbursement every quarter.
_eligibility_text: 1. The Gram Panchayats must within the state of Jharkhand. 1. The Gram Panchayat must have an operational Panchayat Secretariat in place to receive and utilize the grant. 1. The Gram Panchayat must maintain proper records, documentation, and reconciliation of expenditures to continue receiving support under the scheme.
